jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Anterior:

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates (NEA), and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.

We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team:

At Anterior, we work in small, cross-functional teams — engineering, clinical, product, and customer-facing — to solve real problems for large enterprise customers. This role sits at the intersection of those teams, owning how we translate customer needs into technical solutions and get them into production.

About You:

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way. You believe Less is More. You've run programs at companies where execution actually mattered — where slipping a deadline meant real consequences, not just a status update. You've seen what good execution looks like at scale, and you've seen what happens when programs are run poorly. You care about the fundamentals: clear scope, real dependencies, honest timelines.

You're technical enough to earn the respect of the engineers you work with. You can read a system design doc, understand a deployment pipeline, and ask the right questions in a postmortem. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the systems well enough to know where the real risks are.

You may be coming from a TPM, solutions architect, or technical deployment role at a scale-up, big tech, or a high-growth startup. What matters is that you've owned complex technical programs end-to-end — scoping solutions for enterprise customers, coordinating across teams, and shipping.

https://電.anterior.app/ — if you find something here that resonates, mention it in your application.

About the Role:

The Technical Solutions Architect at Anterior will own how we design and deliver solutions for our enterprise customers — from scoping integrations through to successful deployment. You'll work across engineering, product, clinical, and customer-facing teams to drive programs that span our platform, integrations, and enterprise deployments.

  • Designing and driving end-to-end solutions for enterprise customers, from scoping through delivery

  • Coordinating across engineering, product, clinical, and customer teams to keep enterprise integrations and deployments on track

  • Identifying dependencies, risks, and blockers early — and resolving them before they become problems

  • Building lightweight program management processes that fit a fast-moving ~10-person engineering team (not importing big-company overhead)

  • Managing the cadence of engineering planning, tracking progress, and ensuring the team has clear priorities

  • Working directly with enterprise customers' technical teams to architect integration solutions, scope timelines, and define requirements

  • Driving incident response coordination and postmortem follow-through

  • Contributing to how we scale our deployment and solutions practice — processes, tooling, and playbooks that work for 5 customers and will still work for 50

Tech

You don't need to be a developer, but familiarity with the following will make you effective from day one:

  • Our stack: Python, Go, TypeScript, React

  • Infra: AWS, Nix (our build system), CDKTF

  • Concepts: distributed systems, API integrations, CI/CD pipelines, enterprise deployment patterns

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting-edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We take pride in our strong apprenticeship and coaching culture. We expect our early hires to become leaders both within our company and across the industry. You'll be given a lot of responsibility and the opportunity for rapid growth.

Benefits

  • Equity package

  • Competitive, top-of-market salary

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Catered lunches and a stocked kitchen

  • Commuter benefits

  • Company laptop along w/ tools you need to succeed

  • Learning & development budget

  • Team-building events

  • Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Anterior

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates (NEA), and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.

We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong "sense of product" and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We value diverse experiences and skill sets, continually expanding our team to tackle modern healthcare’s challenges with creativity and precision.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is on the backend and/or infrastructure. You may be the person building APIs, integrations, data pipelines, and distributed systems — or you may be the person scaling and hardening the cloud infrastructure underneath them. Either way, you've owned system design decisions, shipped them to production, and operated them at scale. You've been the person other engineers come to when something is broken or when a design needs a second opinion. You've led projects, mentored junior engineers, and made architectural decisions that stuck. You may be coming from a scale-up, a big tech platform team, an engineering finance shop, or anywhere with a serious AWS footprint — what matters is that you've seen real complexity and you want more ownership over what you build.

Come share your proudest firefighting story with us in an interview, bring your GitHub, and let’s see if we’re a good fit.

https://電.anterior.app/ — if you find something here that resonates, mention it in your application.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff at Anterior own problems end-to-end — from system design through to production. You'll drive technical direction, shape architecture, and set the bar for engineering quality.

A day's work may include:

  • Scaling and hardening our AWS infrastructure to meet growing enterprise demand

  • Analyzing request logs, debugging event streams, and improving system reliability

  • Designing and building backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that power our AI platform

  • Working directly with customers to understand real-world healthcare workflows, scope integrations, and translate requirements into product specs

  • Building internal tooling to automate workflows and increase team leverage

  • Writing evals to identify weaknesses and drive improvements in our LLM-powered systems

  • Working across the stack when needed — from backend services to frontend — to ship complete solutions

  • Contributing to Anterior's SDKs, developer documentation, and platform architecture

Tech

  • Langs: Python / Go / TS, React (and HTMX if you can help!)

  • Infra: Nix, AWS (currently on CDKTF — actively looking to migrate, bonus points if you've done this before)

What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting-edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We take pride in our strong apprenticeship and coaching culture. We expect our early hires to become leaders both within our company and across the industry. You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the opportunity for rapid growth.

Benefits:

  • Equity package

  • Competitive, top-of-market salary

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Catered lunches and a stocked kitchen

  • Commuter benefits

  • Company laptop along w/ tools you need to succeed

  • Learning & development budget

  • Team-building events

  • Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Anterior

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates (NEA), and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We're working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.

We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

 

About the role

At Anterior, Deployment Strategists bring cutting-edge AI to life in the messy real world of payer operations. Our Deployments team is where our software meets that reality, and you'll own a piece of it — running complex customer implementations that sit at the intersection of clinical workflows, technical integration, and hard project management, turning innovative technology into production systems that health plans depend on daily.

You'll work hand-in-hand with AI engineers, clinicians, and subject matter experts to navigate the intricate world of healthcare administration. You'll deploy Florence, Anterior's AI-driven clinical reasoning platform, into a customer's organization by understanding their requirements deeply enough to know how to tailor it to them, translating those needs into clear deployment specifications, and coordinating across engineering, clinical, and customer stakeholder teams to deliver.

You own the end-to-end success of your deployments and can wear whatever hat is needed to get projects over the finish line: designing clinical workflows and process diagrams, writing requirements, defining testing plans, defining and managing to implementation timelines, or presenting to client senior leadership (VP and SVP+).

What you’ll do

  • Own the engagement, end to end. From initial design, through build, testing, and launch. You define what success means with the customer, then hold the line on it.

  • Turn ambiguity into a buildable plan. This is the core craft of the role. You'll take a tangle of clinical policy, legacy systems, regulatory deadlines, and stakeholder opinion and decompose it into clear requirements: functional requirements and acceptance criteria that can be directly handed over to engineering.

  • Consensus build. You get people who don't report to you to commit to a plan and hold to it — both inside Anterior and inside the client. Your job is to get them to one shared plan everyone understands and believes.

  • Go deep into the details. Clinician workflows, payer operations, interoperability standards, and the regulation coming down the pipe. You'll spend real time onsite with our customers building the kind of expertise you can't get from a deck or reading white papers.

  • Be a trusted advisor. You’ll build trust and credibility, becoming an advisor to the customer; the best Deployment Strategists don’t just successfully deliver what customers want, they help customers understand what they need and guide them on how best to get there

About you

You ideally have 4–6 years of experience in management consulting, product management, or a technical customer-facing role at a high-growth software company.

Whatever the path, that experience should have given you:

  • A delivery track record. Proven experience leading complex, high-visibility transformation programs to completion. You understand (and have directly written) a requirements document that an engineer has built.

  • First-principles problem solving. We are building net-new capabilities, so inherited assumptions have to be tested. We're looking for people who don't just know what has worked before, but can reason from the ground up about why it worked and whether it applies here.

  • Technical credibility. You can read API documentation, reason about data models and system architecture, and follow an engineering tradeoff discussion well enough to have an opinion.

  • Curiosity and empathy. You are comfortable to say “I don’t know”, but are not satisfied with that answer — you have a desire to learn and become an expert in any content domain you’re in, with excitement around how you can help transform US healthcare.

Even better:

  • You've worked in or around payers, providers, or health tech — utilization management, prior authorization, risk adjustment, HEDIS, claims, or interoperability (FHIR, Da Vinci, X12).

  • You've deployed AI/LLM-based systems into production and are hands-on with the tooling behind them: evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, retrieval, agent orchestration.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or early operator, and know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

If you do not have all these qualities and experiences, you should still apply if you think the rest of this section describes you

What's in it for You

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting-edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We take pride in our strong apprenticeship and coaching culture. We expect our early hires to become leaders both within our company and across the industry. You’ll be given a lot of responsibility and the opportunity for rapid growth.

Benefits:

  • Competitive, top-of-market salary

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Catered lunches and a stocked kitchen

  • Commuter benefits

  • Company laptop along w/ tools you need to succeed

  • Learning & development budget

  • Team-building events

  • Flexible PTO

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Anterior

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates (NEA), and Neo, along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

We're building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Role

Anterior's engineering team builds the platform health plans rely on for clinical decision-making at enterprise scale. As we grow, we need engineering leaders who keep the team moving quickly, hold a high bar for quality, and help every engineer do the best work of their career.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead and grow a team of around 10-15 engineers in our New York office. You'll be responsible for the people on your team — how they're hired, how they grow, and how they work together — and for what the team delivers. This is a player-coach role, roughly 70% leading people and 30% hands-on: you'll stay close to the technical work, take part in design decisions, and contribute hands-on where it gives the team the most leverage.

You'll work closely with our founders and with our product and clinical teams, and you'll help shape how engineering at Anterior is organized as we scale.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow the team

  • Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and honest feedback (gather feedback for a team member from their peers/collaborators, and assess/message that feedback), and build development plans that help strong engineers become standout ones.

  • Own performance reviews and career growth for your team, in line with our growth model.

  • Hire for your team: define roles with us, run interview loops, assess for competence and fit, and close the engineers we want most.

  • Build a team culture of ownership, care, and high standards.

Deliver for our customers

  • Plan and sequence the team's work in cooperation with TL (team lead) and TPM (technical program manager) so that execution is predictable and quality stays high.

  • Partner with product, clinical, and customer-facing teams to turn real healthcare workflows into roadmaps and specs.

  • Work with our enterprise customers' technical teams to scope integrations and support deployments.

  • Own the reliability of your team's systems: keep your engineers' on-call rotation healthy, act as an escalation point during incidents, and drive postmortem follow-through.

Stay close to the technical work

  • Review system designs, architecture decisions, and code, and help the team make sound trade-offs (foster collaboration and organic decision-making in the team).

  • Contribute hands-on where it gives the team leverage: prototyping, debugging, or building internal tooling.

Help shape engineering at Anterior

  • Raise the bar on engineering practices and standards as the team grows.

  • Work with leadership on team structure, hiring plans, and how we scale the engineering organization.

We're Looking For

You're an engineer who became a manager because you care about building strong teams. You believe in keeping things simple and getting the foundations right, and you know that good engineering is as much about what a team chooses not to build. What we care about:

  • You have 8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years as an engineering manager responsible for hiring, performance, and career development.

  • Your technical depth is in backend and/or infrastructure: APIs, integrations, data pipelines, distributed systems, or the cloud infrastructure underneath them. You've owned system design decisions and operated systems in production at scale.

  • You still enjoy the technical work, and you can hold your own in a design review and in code development and review.

  • You've grown engineers into senior and lead roles, and your feedback is direct, specific, and kind.

  • You have sound delivery judgment. You know how to scope, sequence, and cut in order to ship reliably.

  • You've worked somewhere with real complexity — a scale-up, a big tech platform team, an engineering-focused finance firm, or anywhere with a serious AWS footprint.

  • Healthcare experience is a plus, but not required.

This Isn't For You If

  • You want to step away from technical work entirely. This role stays close to the code and the systems.

  • You'd rather inherit a well-defined process. We're still building ours, and you'll help shape it.

  • You're looking for a remote role. This role is based in our New York office.

Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS, React and HTMX

  • Infra: Nix, AWS (currently on CDKTF — actively looking to migrate; experience leading a migration like this is a plus)

What's in it for you

THE ROLE

Anterior's engineering team builds the platform health plans rely on for clinical decision-making at enterprise scale. As we grow, we need engineering leaders who keep the team moving quickly, hold a high bar for quality, and help every engineer do the best work of their career.

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead and grow a team of around 10-15 engineers in our New York office. You'll be responsible for the people on your team — how they're hired, how they grow, and how they work together — and for what the team delivers. This is a player-coach role, roughly 70% leading people and 30% hands-on: you'll stay close to the technical work, take part in design decisions, and contribute hands-on where it gives the team the most leverage.

You'll work closely with our founders and with our product and clinical teams, and you'll help shape how engineering at Anterior is organized as we scale.




WHAT YOU'LL DO




LEAD AND GROW THE TEAM

 - Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and honest feedback (gather feedback for a team member from their peers/collaborators, and assess/message that feedback), and build development plans that help strong engineers become standout ones.

 - Own performance reviews and career growth for your team, in line with our growth model.

 - Hire for your team: define roles with us, run interview loops, assess for competence and fit, and close the engineers we want most.

 - Build a team culture of ownership, care, and high standards.


DELIVER FOR OUR CUSTOMERS

 - Plan and sequence the team's work in cooperation with TL (team lead) and TPM (technical program manager) so that execution is predictable and quality stays high.

 - Partner with product, clinical, and customer-facing teams to turn real healthcare workflows into roadmaps and specs.

 - Work with our enterprise customers' technical teams to scope integrations and support deployments.

 - Own the reliability of your team's systems: keep your engineers' on-call rotation healthy, act as an escalation point during incidents, and drive postmortem follow-through.


STAY CLOSE TO THE TECHNICAL WORK

 - Review system designs, architecture decisions, and code, and help the team make sound trade-offs (foster collaboration and organic decision-making in the team).

 - Contribute hands-on where it gives the team leverage: prototyping, debugging, or building internal tooling.


HELP SHAPE ENGINEERING AT ANTERIOR

 - Raise the bar on engineering practices and standards as the team grows.

 - Work with leadership on team structure, hiring plans, and how we scale the engineering organization.




WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're an engineer who became a manager because you care about building strong teams. You believe in keeping things simple and getting the foundations right, and you know that good engineering is as much about what a team chooses not to build. What we care about:

 - You have 8+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years as an engineering manager responsible for hiring, performance, and career development.

 - Your technical depth is in backend and/or infrastructure: APIs, integrations, data pipelines, distributed systems, or the cloud infrastructure underneath them. You've owned system design decisions and operated systems in production at scale.

 - You still enjoy the technical work, and you can hold your own in a design review and in code development and review.

 - You've grown engineers into senior and lead roles, and your feedback is direct, specific, and kind.

 - You have sound delivery judgment. You know how to scope, sequence, and cut in order to ship reliably.

 - You've worked somewhere with real complexity — a scale-up, a big tech platform team, an engineering-focused finance firm, or anywhere with a serious AWS footprint.

 - Healthcare experience is a plus, but not required.




THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF

 - You want to step away from technical work entirely. This role stays close to the code and the systems.

 - You'd rather inherit a well-defined process. We're still building ours, and you'll help shape it.

 - You're looking for a remote role. This role is based in our New York office.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Anterior

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We've built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we're revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We're growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates (NEA), and Neo, along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

We're building exciting tech for huge customers, and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Role

We're growing quickly, so our operations need to keep pace with our products. As Operations Manager, you'll tackle challenges across the business and see them through from start to finish. This might involve helping teams work better together, setting up new systems, or making sure projects get completed. As the company grows, your responsibilities will change too. We're looking for someone who likes variety and can learn fast.

You'll report to our VP of Operations and work with all our teams, including engineering, clinical, Frontier, GTM, and finance. Since we sell AI, we use it in our own work too. We want you to automate your tasks first, then help others do the same. Our team works together in person in NYC, five days a week. As the company grows, this role can become a key part of our operations team.

What You'll Do

  • Own projects across the business. Work with the VP of Operations and team leads to tackle the problems that matter most as we grow. Figure out the problem, recommend a practical approach, and see it through, whether that's improving a process, coordinating a rollout, or sorting out something we've never dealt with before.

  • Own IT and business systems. Manage identity and access (Rippling, Okta), provisioning and deprovisioning, devices and inventory, AI tooling and API access, and SaaS spend. Make one-click onboarding and offboarding real.

  • Keep us compliant and audit-ready. Run SOC 2 Type 2 and HITRUST evidence collection with engineering and our compliance vendors. Answer customer security questionnaires and keep our policies current (BCP, DR, privacy, code of conduct).

  • Build the operating system. Maintain how work is organized and tracked (charge codes, project spaces, contract and BAA/SLA trackers). Run the weekly ops cadence. Write the SOPs that let processes run without you.

  • Manage vendors and contracts. Be the admin owner for operational vendors: scope, negotiate, renew, or cancel.

  • Partner with our Head of People. Support the operational side of onboarding and offboarding and some recruiting coordination where needed. Our Head of People leads the employee lifecycle and recruiting; your main focus is broader company operations.

  • Automate relentlessly. Turn repeated work into Claude skills, scripts and integrations, and measure the time it gives back.

We're Looking For

We're looking for an ambitious generalist who wants to take on real responsibility and help build the company. In particular:

  • Own the outcome. You take initiative, follow through, and keep people informed. When something gets difficult, you work through it and flag problems early.

  • Bring intensity and good judgment. You move quickly, work reliably under pressure, and stay constructive when priorities change. People enjoy working with you, even on difficult days.

  • Care about the details. You produce work others can rely on and know where getting something right matters most. You also know when it's good enough to move forward.

  • Learn quickly and openly. You ask good questions, seek out expertise, take feedback well, and change your mind when the evidence calls for it.

  • Make the team better. You're willing to do the unglamorous work and leave behind tools and processes that make things easier for everyone.

Experience and skills

  • Around 3–5 years of experience in consulting, business operations, or another demanding generalist role. You might have spent 3–4 years in consulting and then a year at a startup. We'd value that combination, but care more about what you've taken ownership of and delivered than a particular career path.

  • You can bring structure to an unclear problem, work through the numbers, and make a clear recommendation. You're equally comfortable doing the hands-on work to put it into practice.

  • Experience with business systems or security compliance is useful, but you don't need to have done every part of this role before.

  • You already use AI to do your job better and enjoy finding ways to reduce manual work. You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring out how to connect them; scripting or API experience is a plus.

  • Sound judgment with sensitive information (compensation, performance, PHI).

  • Healthcare or health-tech experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Based in New York (or willing to relocate) and excited to work in person five days a week.

If you're not sure you meet every point but believe you're the right fit, please apply anyway.

What's in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at a major inflection point, using cutting-edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You'll work with a world-class team, take on real responsibility early, and shape how Anterior operates as it scales.

We take pride in our strong apprenticeship and coaching culture. We expect our early hires to become leaders both within our company and across the industry.

Benefits:

  • Equity package

  • Competitive, top-of-market salary

  • 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Complimentary lunches and a stocked kitchen

  • Commuter benefits

  • Company laptop along with the tools you need to succeed

  • Learning & development budget

  • Team-building events

  • Flexible PTO
